name: Palace Residences North
overview: Palace Residences North stands as a testament to the exceptional architectural prowess of Emaar Properties. This waterfront development situated on the tranquil shores of Dubai Creek offers branded housing units tailored to those seeking a premium living experience. The development neighbors the 5-star Palace hotel providing residents with access to its high-end services, all the while savouring breathtaking views. With its luxurious design impressive interiors ample spaces and abundant lighting the living experience at Palace Residences North is truly matchless.
